subject: Next steps & pilot scope — Ignite Analytics discovery
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Park <evan.park@igniteanalytics.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@igniteanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & pilot scope — Ignite Analytics discovery

Thanks for taking time today — quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned.

Key pain points you confirmed:
- Inference latency spikes on batch transformations for customer-facing features (95th pct > 800ms).
- Token costs are rising with current caching strategy; need predictable unit economics.
- Auditability/trace for model outputs is required for regulated customers.

Primary goals for the pilot (measurable):
1) Reduce 95th-percentile response latency to <= 300ms for 1–2 high-priority routes.
2) Lower per-token serving cost by 30% via batching + prefix caching under expected load.
3) Produce a reproducible eval suite and prompts that enable guardrails for high-risk queries.

Proposed pilot scope (4 weeks):
- Week 0: Access + environment setup (AWS account role, sample data + prompt set).
- Week 1: Baseline run (your stack + Redwood hosted endpoint), collect latency/cost metrics.
- Week 2: Apply batching + caching config, run A/B, collect metrics.
- Week 3: Quality evals on prompt set, iterate on prompt templates and failure handling.
- Week 4: Wrap-up, handoff doc, and next-phase recommendation (Dedicated vs Private).

Owners (suggested):
- Ignite technical lead: Evan Park (we’ll need an engineer for access).
- Redwood solutions: Ben Carter (onsite configuration & evals).
- Redwood AE: Jasmine Liu (commercial and timeline).

Immediate asks from Ignite to get the pilot scheduled:
1) Provide an AWS role ARN with limited read-only access to the test bucket and a small sample dataset (or a signed URL).
2) SOC2 contact and any security checklist items we should pre-fill — we can respond to an evidence pack within 48–72 hours.
3) Approve the attached SOW and the access checklist so Ben can start the baseline next week.

Attachments: ignite-pilot-sow.pdf (SOW draft), ignite-access-checklist.xlsx (access instructions + role checklist)

If that matches your understanding I’ll send a calendar invite for a 30-min kickoff on Monday and route the SOW to Priya for signature.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0183

From: Evan Park <evan.park@igniteanalytics.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@igniteanalytics.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps & pilot scope — Ignite Analytics discovery

Appreciate the clear summary, Jasmine — that aligns with our internal notes. A few clarifications and constraints from our side: 

Security/compliance:
- We do have a small SOC2 evidence packet; our security team will want to review any data flows.
- For the pilot we can provide obfuscated sample data (PII removed) but will need to see the data retention and audit settings in Redwood (logs retention, who can access logs).

Access details:
- I’ll create an IAM role for the pilot environment. Expect the role ARN by end of day Monday (I’ll send the ARN to Ben directly).
- We prefer the baseline to run against a subset of traffic (non-production route).

Timeline constraints:
- We’re targeting a vendor selection decision by the second week of July, so a 4-week pilot in June would work, but we need kickoff no later than June 8.

Commercial note:
- There’s a small pilot budget (internal PO) but procurement will need the SOW and an initial estimate. Priya (cc) is our procurement lead and will coordinate the PO.

Thanks — Evan
Evan Park
Head of ML Engineering | Ignite Analytics
evan.park@igniteanalytics.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Park <evan.park@igniteanalytics.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@igniteanalytics.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps & pilot scope — Ignite Analytics discovery

Evan — great, thanks for the quick response. A few technical confirmations from my side before kickoff: 

Baseline checklist (what I’ll run first):
- Small load generator against the non-prod route you specify (we’ll coordinate a traffic window).
- Token-level tracing enabled to map prompt-to-cost and identify hot prefixes.
- Latency sampling at 50ms bins for 95th/99th pct comparison.

We’ll need these from Ignite to accelerate Day 0: 
1) IAM role ARN (with sts:AssumeRole) and an initial test bucket path OR a signed URL for sample data.
2) Example API keys or headers used by your client so we can mirror auth flow (we’ll only use for baseline test).
3) Any IP allowlist or SSO redirect URIs required for the Redwood console access.

I’ve attached the SOW (ignite-pilot-sow.pdf) with a short appendix describing our evaluation dashboards and the prompt/eval template we’ll use. I’m proposing these milestone dates:
- Kickoff & access validation: June 8
- Baseline collection: June 9–11
- Configuration + A/B: June 14–18
- Eval & review: June 21–24
- Final wrap & recommendations: June 25

If we get the role and the checklist Monday, I can start the baseline Tuesday morning.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0120

Attachments: ignite-pilot-sow.pdf, ignite-access-checklist.xlsx

Thanks — confirming we’ll proceed with the June 8 kickoff.

Quick updates from procurement/security: 
- I’ve uploaded a small PO template to our procurement portal and can sign an initial non-binding SOW for the pilot once we have a short commercial estimate.
- Security: I’ll share the SOC2 point-of-contact (Alison Chen) and the security checklist we use; Alison will reach out if she needs additional evidence.

Evan has sent the IAM role ARN in a separate internal thread (I’ll forward to Ben as requested). We will provide the obfuscated sample dataset via a signed S3 URL by EOD today.
